events.content:
Migration complete and verified with a clean typecheck, build, and dev-server smoke test.

**Summary of the migration** (Pages Router → App Router):

| Pages Router | App Router | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Merged into one root layout |
| `pages/_error.js` (`getInitialProps`) | `app/error.tsx` + `app/global-error.tsx` | `getInitialProps` doesn't exist in App Router; replaced with the `error.tsx` convention (client boundary with `reset()`) plus a `global-error.tsx` for root-layout failures |
| `pages/404.js` (`useRouter`) | `app/not-found.tsx` | Server component using `<Link>` instead of client-side `router.push` |
| `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) | `app/page.tsx` | Async server component; `req.headers` → `headers()` from `next/headers`; `fetch(..., { cache: 'no-store' })` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps` + `revalidate: 60`) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } })` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths` + `fallback: 'blocking'` + `getStaticProps`) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `generateStaticParams()` + `notFound: true` → `notFound()`; `router.isFallback` no longer needed (App Router streams/SSRs unknown paths automatically since `dynamicParams` defaults to true); added `generateMetadata` |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js`, `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts`, `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `(req, res)` handler → per-method exports (`GET`/`POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE`) using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`; manual 405/`Allow` header handling removed since Route Handlers do this automatically |
| `<Head>` from `next/head` | Static/dynamic `metadata`/`generateMetadata` exports | Used throughout for titles, descriptions, OG tags |
| `useRouter` from `next/router` | `useRouter`/`notFound` from `next/navigation` | Interactive bits (`router.push`, `router.back`) split into small `'use client'` components (`HomeActions`, `BlogPostCard`, `BackButton`) since pages are async server components |
| `styles/globals.css` | `app/globals.css` | Imported in the root layout |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` | Added types + explicit `'use client'` (required since it uses `useState`/context) |

Also removed the `pages/` and `styles/` directories entirely, deleted the stale `AppProvider.js`, and confirmed with `tsc --noEmit` (clean) and `next build` (route table shows `/` dynamic, `/blog` ISR 60s, `/blog/[id]` SSG with 5min revalidate for 10 paths, matching original semantics) plus a `next dev` smoke test of every route.

| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Merged into one root layout |
| `pages/_error.js` (`getInitialProps`) | `app/error.tsx` + `app/global-error.tsx` | `getInitialProps` doesn't exist in App Router; replaced with the `error.tsx` convention (client boundary with `reset()`) plus a `global-error.tsx` for root-layout failures |
| `pages/404.js` (`useRouter`) | `app/not-found.tsx` | Server component using `<Link>` instead of client-side `router.push` |
| `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) | `app/page.tsx` | Async server component; `req.headers` → `headers()` from `next/headers`; `fetch(..., { cache: 'no-store' })` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps` + `revalidate: 60`) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } })` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths` + `fallback: 'blocking'` + `getStaticProps`) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `generateStaticParams()` + `notFound: true` → `notFound()`; `router.isFallback` no longer needed (App Router streams/SSRs unknown paths automatically since `dynamicParams` defaults to true); added `generateMetadata` |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js`, `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts`, `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `(req, res)` handler → per-method exports (`GET`/`POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE`) using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`; manual 405/`Allow` header handling removed since Route Handlers do this automatically |
| `<Head>` from `next/head` | Static/dynamic `metadata`/`generateMetadata` exports | Used throughout for titles, descriptions, OG tags |
| `useRouter` from `next/router` | `useRouter`/`notFound` from `next/navigation` | Interactive bits (`router.push`, `router.back`) split into small `'use client'` components (`HomeActions`, `BlogPostCard`, `BackButton`) since pages are async server components |
| `styles/globals.css` | `app/globals.css` | Imported in the root layout |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` | Added types + explicit `'use client'` (required since it uses `useState`/context) |

Also removed the `pages/` and `styles/` directories entirely, deleted the stale `AppProvider.js`, and confirmed with `tsc --noEmit` (clean) and `next build` (route table shows `/` dynamic, `/blog` ISR 60s, `/blog/[id]` SSG with 5min revalidate for 10 paths, matching original semantics) plus a `next dev` smoke test of every route.
